cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Let's pack your paintings for the last gallery. You've finally picked up a brush again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If the big gallery rejected me too, I'm done. Did they write?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Their letter can wait. This gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them, then. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's pack your paintings for the last gallery. You've finally picked up a brush again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If the big gallery rejected me too, I'm done. Did they write?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their letter can wait. This gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them, then. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the seed packets. The allotment letter says we're on the waiting list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered our number. If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up gardening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The important bit is we're on it. Let's start tomatoes on my windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll get tired of them before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my sunny room. I'll move the bed; keep the packets.

cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did the boss calling us office furniture hurt you?

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's still in drafts. How did you feel?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Invisible. I've worked here twelve years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. Mine says 'unprofessional'; I'm changing that to 'I went home and cried.'

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. That rejection was exactly the lesson our bakery needed.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A powerful second lesson about attachment to equipment.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'm ready for our audition results. Why are you breathing like that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Four in, six out. It stops my hands shaking.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I also write down who I'll call if I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. One sleepless night before your interview? I've been awake all week worrying about mine.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your opening had empty seats? Mine had two people, and both left.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Ask why I left my last job. You'll understand why my interview is harder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm scared I'll freeze.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm scared I'll cry. Let's use your practice time to get me through the greeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your opening had empty seats? Mine had two people, and both left.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. Have my complimentary drink.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. My theatre couldn't even afford to console us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you listen now? My dad left before my scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mine asked for a refund. Could you stay while I finish this? I haven't told anyone that.
